//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the filter-card component. See ../README.md and card.json for the model. filter-card has NO .pa-filter-card base rule — the wrapper carries BOTH pa-card (chrome) + pa-filter-card (so the modifiers latch on). The body is a pa-card__body holding a __row (= __filters + __actions) and an optional collapsible __advanced block (= advanced content + __advanced-actions). Goldens encode the canonical snippets/filter-card.html shape. Built-in action buttons (toggle/clear/refresh) + the advanced Clear/Apply buttons are wrapper CHROME, not slots; most scenarios turn them OFF (showToggle/showClear/showRefresh/showAdvancedActions=false) so __actions / __advanced read as clean structural divs that both wrappers agree on. A dedicated 'builtin-actions' scenario exercises the icon buttons at the canonical bare-pa-icon shape (NO pa-btn__icon wrapper — matches snippets/buttons.html L393 + button.json icon-only golden); 'advanced-actions' exercises the text Clear/Apply footer buttons.

propsVocabulary.expanded: boolean — advanced section visible (only renders with advancedFilters present)
propsVocabulary.showToggle: boolean — render the built-in expand/collapse icon button (only with advancedFilters)
propsVocabulary.showClear: boolean — render the built-in clear-all icon button
propsVocabulary.showRefresh: boolean — render the built-in refresh icon button
propsVocabulary.showAdvancedActions: boolean — render the Clear/Apply text buttons in the advanced footer
propsVocabulary.actions: author action buttons rendered inside pa-filter-card__actions before the built-in clear/refresh

goldenConventions: Structural. Slot content is a plain text token (Filters/Advanced/Actions) so the diff checks the wrapper's nesting, not rich content. Both wrappers ALWAYS emit the pa-card > pa-card__body > __row > __filters + __actions skeleton; filters is supplied in every scenario because keen renders __filters unconditionally (no :if) while svelte gates it on the filters slot — a shared filters slot keeps them aligned. The built-in icon buttons use the canonical BARE pa-icon shape (span.pa-icon directly inside the button, aria-hidden, NO pa-btn__icon wrapper) per snippets/filter-card.html + button.json's icon-only golden. Attribute + class-token order are normalized away; title text on the icon buttons is wrapper chrome text (identical EN strings in both) and IS compared.

features.//: Feature->class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. Block-modifier reverse-check covers pa-filter-card--loading/--disabled. Element classes verified forward via scenario goldens.

actions.note: author buttons placed inside pa-filter-card__actions (which is always emitted)

expanded.note: structural — reveals the __advanced block (no class of its own)

showToggle.note: built-in toggle icon button (chrome, no filter-card class)

deferred.//: __row / __actions are exercised by every scenario golden; __filters / __advanced / __advanced-actions each have scenarios. Nothing left out of scope.

scenarios.name: basic
scenarios.note: All built-in buttons off -> __actions is an empty structural div. Both wrappers emit the full pa-card>__body>__row>__filters+__actions skeleton.

scenarios.name: actions-slot
scenarios.note: Author actions slot content lands inside __actions.

scenarios.name: advanced
scenarios.note: Advanced block renders only when advancedFilters present AND expanded. Advanced footer buttons off here so __advanced reads as a clean structural div.

scenarios.name: advanced-collapsed
scenarios.note: Not expanded -> no __advanced block in SSR markup.
